messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

a family history of long QT syndrome
a recent heart attack
heart failure that is not well controlled
a slow or irregular heartbeat (bradyarrhythmia)
other conditions that make heart rhythm problems more likely
Hydroxyzine should not be given to women who are breastfeeding.
It is not known whether hydroxyzine passes into breast milk.
Many medicines do.
The oral solution contains a small amount of alcohol, 0.5% by volume.

Triplet: ["Hydroxyzine", "contains", "sucrose"]

The relation 'contains' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug includes or is composed of the substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'has rules on': The subject drug is subject to the rules specified by the object entity.
C. 'has metabolism characteristic': The subject drug is metabolized with the characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'used alone or in combination with': The subject drug is administered either by itself or together with the entity specified by the object entity.
